description: A React component for displaying a modal when a user is removed from a channel in Mattermost, including localization support and handling of props and state.

classes.name: RemovedFromChannelModal
classes.description: A React component that renders a modal informing the user they have been removed from a channel.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component state with show set to true.

methods.name: onHide
methods.description: Handles hiding the modal by setting show to false.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the modal with localized messages, handling props for channel name and remover, and manages visibility based on currentUserId.
